checks.name: First instance exits successfully after /q download
Exit follows persisted completion
Exit-after-download file matches every source byte
Existing isolated app is running
Forwarded /q command is accepted
Forwarded /q never closes the existing instance
Forwarded download has exact source bytes
Queue-only /q remains paused without exiting or downloading
Failed download does not trigger /q exit
Bare /q has no exit or download side effect
Both first-launch and forwarded additions are paused queue members
Both CLI destinations and filenames are preserved
No HTTP request or output file before explicit start
Restart retains both paused queue members
Restart does not initiate either transfer
Browser host rejects cli-add without queue side effects
Browser host rejects cli-start-queue without queue side effects
Rejected browser commands leave downloads paused and unchanged
Forwarded scheduler start downloads both queued files with exact bytes
Explicit queue-start begins network transfers
Adding after a finished queue still waits for explicit start
First-launch scheduler start resumes the saved queue and writes exact bytes

scope: Actual integrated UDM.exe; loopback HTTP sources, private catalogs, unique instance tags; browser-native registration unchanged.
limitations: Queue restart uses test-owned process termination after persisted state, not a physical power-loss test.
Native-host admission tested over test bridge, not through a live browser.
No GUI appearance, public-site speed or installed app replacement in this test.
